sections.heading: Auro University vs Veer Narmad South Gujarat University for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Auro University if you want a 2023 flagship package record of ₹5 LPA, and a recorded fee of ₹3.58 lakh, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Surat.
Choose Veer Narmad South Gujarat University if you want a 2022 flagship package record of ₹2 LPA, and a recorded fee of ₹1.3 lakh, in a public MBA / PGDM setting at Surat.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.
Our records show ₹3.58 lakh as a tuition figure for MBA Finance at Auro University. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

Our records show ₹1.3 lakh as a tuition figure for MBA (Dual Specialisation) at Veer Narmad South Gujarat University. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Auro University's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹5 LPA and a highest package of ₹13 LPA on MBA Finance. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

Veer Narmad South Gujarat University's latest recorded flagship year here is 2022, with an average of ₹2 LPA and a highest package of ₹4 LPA on MBA (Dual Specialisation). These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
The recorded years are 2023 and 2022, so the packages should not be read as a head-to-head for the same graduating class.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Gujarat. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
Auro University is listed as a private institute and Veer Narmad South Gujarat University as a public institute on our records. That difference can affect fees, seat reservations and campus culture.
